queue.title: Access Rights Audit After a Role Change
queue.content:
Access rights outliving a role change become the most common, least detected security gap. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

Access rights that outlive an employee's role change become the most common, and least frequently detected, security gap.

Access rights that outlive an employee's role change become the most common, and least frequently detected, security gap.

When an employee changes department or leaves the company, removing access to old systems is often delayed or forgotten entirely, leaving open access no one is actively monitoring.

The accumulation of outdated access rights over the years creates a security risk proportional to the number of role changes in the organisation, not just the number of current employees.

Automated access-rights review tied to the HR system — which flags the need for reassessment at every role change — closes that gap without relying on an administrator's manual memory.

A quarterly review of all active access, with mandatory manager confirmation that the permissions are still needed, is standard practice in mature security programs.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/access-rights-audit-after-role-change/

queue.title: Cost of Capital and Investment Decisions
queue.content:
A project profitable by nominal return can still destroy value if it misses the weighted cost of capital. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

A project that looks profitable by nominal return can destroy value if it doesn't exceed the company's weighted cost of capital.

A project that looks profitable by nominal return can destroy value if it doesn't exceed the company's weighted cost of capital.

Weighted average cost of capital (WACC) represents the minimum return a project must achieve to justify the investment, accounting for both the cost of debt and the expected return required by equity holders. A project with a positive nominal return but a return below WACC formally reduces company value, even when it looks profitable on paper.

Consistently applying a single discount rate across all capital projects, rather than adjusting the rate to fit a given project's ambitions, prevents the systematic favouring of projects that are politically desirable rather than economically justified. Regularly updating WACC as interest rates change further protects that discipline.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/cost-of-capital-and-investment-decisions/

queue.title: Procurement Digitalization and Supplier Transparency
queue.content:
A digital procurement platform is valuable for improving chain-wide visibility, not just single-order speed. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

A digital procurement platform is only as valuable as how much it improves visibility across the whole chain, not just the speed of a single order.

A digital procurement platform is only as valuable as how much it improves visibility across the whole chain, not just the speed of a single order.

Many companies digitalise procurement for speed — automated purchase orders, electronic approval, ERP integration — while the real added value comes only once the platform centralises delivery history, delays, and per-supplier price deviations in one place.

Requiring every new supplier to go through a structured digital evaluation before onboarding, rather than entering data retroactively, builds a database that is comparable and reliable from day one. Without that step, digitalisation only speeds up existing, often incomplete processes.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/procurement-digitalization-and-supplier-transparency/
